title: Naming bind adopts routing_token/work_binding/rebind_required without a session mutation stamp, so the delta persist may not save it
outcome: Every naming-bind adoption of routing_token, work_binding or rebind_required is durably persisted on its own, not only when some other change happens to stamp the session.
acceptance: Whether the naming-bind adoption at engram_source_roots.rs (bind_fresh_engram_source_root_until) is included in the next delta persist without a mutation stamp is established from source, with a disposable-store test that reloads after the persist.

If it is not durable: the adoption goes through the stamping accessor, or an equivalent, and the reload test shows routing_token, work_binding and rebind_required persisted; the review pair is clean and the gates pass. If it is durable: the mechanism is named on the item and the item is closed as expected behaviour.
